source_caption_text:
Imagine doing this to Lil Baby 😂🔥

Back in 2017, Lil Baby was still early in his career when an older fan walked up to the stage during one of his performances and tucked a few dollar bills straight into his pocket. The whole thing happened while Lil Baby was still rapping, making the moment even more random.

Lil Baby didn’t stop his verse or miss a beat. He reached into his pocket, pulled the money back out and tossed it onto the ground as security stepped in and moved the fan away from the stage.

The clip resurfaced years later and had fans laughing at how casually the whole thing played out. A lot of the jokes came from how the fan was treating Lil Baby like he was performing for tips at a local spot, years before he became one of rap’s biggest names.

#lilbaby #rap #meme
